business_summary: Bright Oceans Inter-Telecom Corporation provides in the computer and communications services in China. The company offers industry-specific digital software development, technical services, system integration, and overall solutions, such as intelligent operation and maintenance systems; providing software and hardware solutions and system integration services for operation and control systems, including telecommunications network operation support systems OSS; and business management support systems, such as telecommunications management support systems, and visual decision-making process scheduling systems. It also provides software products comprising data middleware, digital twin platform, video surveillance platform, and IoT monitoring platform; digital and intelligent solutions and integration services for vertical industries, such as telecommunications, energy, government, finance, and rail transportation; and digital and industry products. In addition, the company offers transportation products, including highway toll collection, highway network monitoring, highway tunnel monitoring, highway provincial toll collection, highway provincial monitoring network, ETC electronic non-stop toll collection, highway command and dispatch, highway digital emergency rescue management, highway business intelligence management, tunnel monitoring, video vehicle detection, urban traffic management signal control system, traffic signal control and traffic flow detection, red light violation monitoring and management, highway artery monitoring and management, 122 emergency response, mobile speeding violation recording, mobile highway vehicle monitoring, and GPS/GSM vehicle monitoring and dispatching systems; highway information management and urban intelligent traffic management platform; and area controller and toll lane controller. Bright Oceans Inter-Telecom Corporation was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Harbin, China.
business_summary_ko: Bright Oceans Inter-Telecom Corporation은 중국에서 컴퓨터 및 통신 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 산업별 디지털 소프트웨어 개발, 기술 서비스, 시스템 통합 및 지능형 운영 및 유지 관리 시스템과 같은 전반적인 솔루션을 제공합니다. 통신 네트워크 운영 지원 시스템 OSS를 포함한 운영 및 제어 시스템을 위한 소프트웨어 및 하드웨어 솔루션과 시스템 통합 서비스를 제공합니다. 통신관리지원시스템, 시각적 의사결정 프로세스 스케줄링 시스템 등 경영지원 시스템 등을 포함한다. 또한 데이터 미들웨어, 디지털 트윈 플랫폼, 영상 감시 플랫폼, IoT 모니터링 플랫폼으로 구성된 소프트웨어 제품도 제공합니다. 통신, 에너지, 정부, 금융, 철도 운송 등 수직 산업을 위한 디지털 및 지능형 솔루션과 통합 서비스; 디지털 및 산업 제품. 또한 회사는 고속도로 통행료 징수, 고속도로 네트워크 모니터링, 고속도로 터널 모니터링, 고속도로 지방 통행료 징수, 고속도로 지방 모니터링 네트워크, ETC 전자 번호를 포함한 운송 제품을 제공합니다.
